key_concepts: A mixture is two or more substances physically combined
Mixtures are not chemically combined and can be separated physically
Homogeneous mixtures have uniform composition and properties throughout
In homogeneous mixtures the components cannot be distinguished
In heterogeneous mixtures the components can be easily distinguished
Solid-solid mixtures combine two or more different solids
Solid-liquid mixtures may show settling of heavier solid particles
Liquid-liquid mixtures combine two or more different liquids
Examples include cake mix, fruit salad, sand and water, vinegar and water, and oil and wat
Some materials like carbon or pure water are not mixtures
Air and halo-halo are examples of mixtures
